items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: That was when Roosevelt was popular.

ctx.x: awareness or lack of awareness on the part of the musicians? You mentioned Lionel several times. I know he is yet a Republican, but most of them became Democrats, most of the black population.
During that time we leaned mostly towards the Democrats, as I remember. That was when Roosevelt was popular.

The name of Hearst, the first family was very and yet is very prominent in newspaper politicals, on the general scene; the Hearst family, William Randolph Hearst in California at that time. Mr. Hearst was very important in terms of finances, et cetera; do you have any memory of him at all?
